rows.vgi.doc_md:
# supported_encodings

The discovery table of every encoding label the worker accepts. One row per encoding, with a single `label` column (e.g. `UTF-8`, `windows-1252`, `Shift_JIS`). Use it to find valid encoding inputs for `to_utf8_from` and `transcode`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"List the first few supported encoding labels.","sql":"SELECT label FROM charset.main.supported_encodings ORDER BY label LIMIT 5"},{"description":"Count how many encoding labels the worker accepts.","sql":"SELECT count(*) AS n FROM charset.main.supported_encodings"},{"description":"List the supported encodings that can store 'naïve café' losslessly: encode it into each label with transcode, decode it back with to_utf8_from, and keep the labels whose round trip is exact (the decode-only 'replacement' encoding has no encoder, so it is skipped).","sql":"SELECT label FROM charset.main.supported_encodings WHERE label <> 'replacement' AND charset.main.to_utf8_from(charset.main.transcode('naïve café', label), label) = 'naïve café' ORDER BY label"}]
